component.name: NutSync
component.summary: Two-way WebDAV synchronization for the KDE desktop

description.p: NutSync keeps a local folder and a WebDAV directory in sync in both directions. It records the last synchronized state of every entry so it can distinguish local changes, remote changes, and conflicts.

ul.li: Two-way, local-to-remote, and remote-to-local synchronization modes
Content-aware uploads that avoid redundant transfers and overwrites
English and Simplified Chinese interface with system-language detection
Proxy, custom CA, retry backoff, and configurable logging
Conflict copies by default, with local/remote/newest policy options and direct conflict resolution
Configurable recycle bin with deletion backups, restore, and retention
Configuration export and import without exposing passwords
KDE system tray integration with theme-aware monochrome icons
Optional start at login through a standard XDG autostart entry
Passwords stored in KWallet / Secret Service
Exclude patterns for caches, build output, and other local-only data
Selective sync by per-pair relative paths
Per-pair pause and persistent sync history
Linux inotify monitoring for immediate local-change syncs
Optional per-pair limits on how often automatic syncs may start

description.p: The synchronization backend is abstract, so additional protocols can be added without changing the synchronization engine.
Maintenance release: AUR publishing has been removed. The project now publishes only GitHub Release artifacts for x86_64 and aarch64 Arch Linux, built and smoke-tested in CI.

NutSync 0.6.0 adds per-pair pause/resume, persistent sync history, live parallel transfer progress, Digest and Bearer-token authentication, client certificates, local rename detection using WebDAV MOVE, and optional Nextcloud chunked uploads.
Fixes missing retry/trash buttons that produced QLayout warnings at startup and could cause a null-pointer access when selecting a sync pair.
NutSync 0.5.2.
Packaging fix: the GitHub release includes both x86_64 and aarch64 Arch Linux packages, built and smoke-tested in CI.

NutSync 0.5.0 adds selective and one-way sync modes, a configurable recycle bin with restore, conflict resolution actions, configuration import/export, redacted diagnostics, log rotation, network-recovery sync, byte-level transfer limits, 1–4 parallel transfers, live byte-level progress, and failed-item retry.
Fixes the lifetime of the state store while persisting conflict records, found by AddressSanitizer.
Persists conflict records in the SQLite state database and migrates the schema to version 2 with a pre-migration backup.
Adds a conflict list with copy paths and a shortcut to open the containing folder.
Adds configuration and state-database backups, schema-version checks, safer file permissions, and keeps remote response bodies out of user-facing error messages.
Refactors retries around structured errors, removes duplicate whole-sync retries, makes PROPFIND retries cancellable, and adds persistent resumable downloads.
Adds request-level retries with Retry-After handling, resumable downloads, retry and credential regression tests, and a uniform clang-format baseline.
Security release: prevents credentials from being forwarded to a cross-origin redirect, rejects cleartext HTTP credentials outside loopback, and limits automatic retries to transient failures.
Adds the gomodb application ID, migration of existing keychain and autostart data, proxy and custom CA settings, retry backoff, and configurable logging.

Adds an English and Simplified Chinese interface with system-language detection, English fallback, and a language preference. This release also includes the updated CI, content-aware uploads, and theme-aware panel icons.
Adds content comparison before uploads to avoid redundant transfers, theme-aware monochrome tray icons, and KDE-compatible taskbar icon padding.
Adds recursive inotify monitoring, per-pair synchronization rate limits, configurable local deletion propagation, and optional start at login.
Initial release with WebDAV two-way synchronization.
